verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers CPU cores/clocks, NPU TOPS, and memory bandwidth, but contains no mention of PCIe generation/lanes, storage interfaces, USB/Thunderbolt, or other external connectivity specs — the exact I/O headroom details a developer would need to plan a build or dock setup. The pack even explicitly notes Qualcomm withholds other key specs (TDP, process node, max memory capacity), reinforcing that I/O documentation is absent rather than just unlisted.
